recipes.name: Rick & Morty Szechuan Sauce
ingredients: Chili paste (if you’re looking for heat)
instructions: Dry roast red dried Chinese chilis: Sauté them in an un-oiled pan until fragrant. Add boiling water to the pan and let the peppers steep for 30 minutes. - 1 ounce red dried Chinese chilis
Toast Szechuan peppercorns. Once toasted, place in grinder and grind until finely ground. Set aside. - Szechuan peppercorns
Add peppers to food processor along with fresh ginger and blend until paste-like. - Fresh ginger

Sweat some garlic in oil in a pan and add blended peppers. Sauté for about 2 minutes and then add sesame seed oil, some rice wine vinegar, soy sauce, some of our freshly ground Szechuan peppercorns, and brown sugar. Mix until combined. - Garlic - 1 tbsp Sesame seed oil - Rice wine vinegar - Szechuan peppercorns - 3 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tbsp brown sugar
For Method: Fan Recipe Szechuan Sauce:
Sweat some garlic and oil in a pan until fragrant. - Garlic

Add balsamic vinegar, soy sauce, plum sake, a good helping of sriracha sauce, brown sugar, and if you want some heat, add chili paste from previous episode. Also we are going to crush a knob of fresh ginger in there. - Balsamic vinegar - Soy sauce - 3 tbsp of plum sake - Sriracha sauce - 4 tbsp of brown sugar - Chili paste (if you’re looking for heat) - Gresh ginger
Sauté for about 5 minutes until everything is soft and syrupy.
Combine 2 parts Sweet and Sour sauce to 1 part Tangy Barbeque sauce. - McDonald’s Sweet and Sour Sauce - McDonald’s Tangy Barbeque Sauce
